title: TRYPOPHOBIA
description: Mod that adds new dimensions, new weapons and more!
body:
![Trypophobia's Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce11e9f1864ca23e48c2955c87746b66d0614bf1.png)

**What is this mod about?**
Trypophobia is a mod that mainly focuses on adding new dimensions: _The Vision, Prize and The Void_. The Vision is a dimension is based on Trypophobia (the fear of clusters of holes) and Ommetaphobia (the fear of eyes). Prize is a Dimension based on nostalgia and The Void is a representation of eternal Limbo.

**How do I enter the dimension?**
When you add a single glow lichen to the bread recipe it crafts moldy bread. Upon eating it, it will leave a white clump in your inventory. If you eat the white clump you will be transported to The Vision. Prize is able to be entered by crafting a Prize Block and feeding it Bricks and a flint and steel, and then using those blocks to make a nether portal like shape. Hitting someone with a Trinket of Banishment in your off-hand sends them to The Void.

**How do I leave the Vision?**
Either prepare yourself by combining moss and glow lichen before entering The Vision or find green mold clusters on the floors of caves or finding a clump in rare underground structure.

**How do I leave The void**
Currently, dying or cheating with /Dimension is the only way, I'm still adding a way to leave.

**Why should I even go there?**
For new blocks and items only available there. Steel Blocks, for example, is used in most recipes for the new weapons added.

**WHAT THIS MOD ADDS:**

- Bauxite and its variants
- 3 new woodsets
- A whole bunch of different plants
- Steel and its variants
- Watcher (mob)
- Shroomer (mob)
- Hallowbug (mob)
- Fungled (mob)
- Steel Ahlspeiss
- Steel-Gold Longsword
- Lynxfang Scythe
- Steel-Gold Lance
- Rubies
- Ruby Sword
- Ruby Battle Axe
- A LOT of Prize Blocks (beta versions of existing blocks)
- Void Stone and its variants
- Trinkets
- Masks
- New music disc
- 3 new enchantments (Draining, Killstreak, Snowgrave's Curse)
- 3 new dimensions (of course)
- around 10 new biomes for the dimensions

_Note_: For a fun challenge, try to survive this dimension without any items. I've added stuff to the dimension to make you able to get very far into the game without any items!
